items.title: Landsat 4 observation of Tasman Glacier in 1990
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Jesse Allen; Landsat 4 data, University of Maryland Global Land Cover Facility
items.caption: Landsat 4's Thematic Mapper recorded the Tasman Glacier and neighbouring valleys on 30 December 1990. This provides a period satellite observation rather than a modern reconstruction.

items.title: ASTER observation of Tasman Glacier in 2007
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Jesse Allen; NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS and the US/Japan ASTER Science Team
items.caption: ASTER image of the Tasman Glacier on 6 December 2007, illustrating glacial retreat and expansion of terminal lakes since the 1990 Landsat observation.

items.title: NASA Terra MODIS cloud-free view of New Zealand, 2002
items.caption: NASA Terra MODIS true-colour observation of New Zealand, acquired 23 October 2002. Shows the extent and regional coverage of early 2000s orbital environmental observations.

items.title: USGS Landsat archive 100 millionth download, New Zealand, 2017
items.caption: Landsat 8 scene captured over the southwestern North Island on 24 May 2017, used to commemorate the 100 millionth download from the USGS Landsat archive.
